Definition: incense (as increasing to a volume of smoke); hence a worshipper
BiblicalUsage: This word means incense rising in a cloud, and the suppliant who offers it. Ezekiel saw seventy elders burning incense to idols in the dark, and Zephaniah says God's dispersed people will bring Him an offering from beyond the rivers of Ethiopia.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that incense shows what worship really is: something rising to God, and the question is always whether it rises to Him or to an idol.
